items.label: Painted gyp board ceiling (A120 stipple hatch)
items.instanceNote: System per A120's hatch ("PAINTED GYP BOARD CEILING"). Height conflict: A120 reads 8'-10" at Work Stations 010; A510.2 (the source of the draft's PT-07 line) tags 9'-0". Both are architectural RCPs at Rev 4 (08/09/24). This pair is in NO register (C-1/C-8 cover A510.2 vs ID-1.6 only). Verify both renders before hanging the lid; the draft height (9'-0", A510.2 enlarged plan) is the one the DB carries.
